context.transcript:
Good afternoon.
This is Amina Karachi.
I'm calling to check on the status of my mortgage loan application.
Can you help me with that?
Of course, Ms. Karachi.
It looks like your employer verified your current salary yesterday.
Unfortunately, I haven't received a copy of the property appraisal.
Fortunately, I haven't received a copy of the property appraisal yet.
Can you tell me who I should call for that?
Oh, yes.
Kelly Ross did the appraisal.
You can reach her at 555-0127.
I'm sure she can send you a copy of the report right away.
Great.
I'll call her first thing tomorrow.
If all goes well, you should receive an approval letter for the loan next week.

下午好。

幸好，我还没有收到房产评估报告的副本。
能告诉我应该给谁打电话吗？
哦，是的。
Kelly Ross 做了这次评估。
你可以拨打 555-0127 联系她。
我相信她可以马上把报告副本发给你。
太好了。
我明天一早就给她打电话。
如果一切顺利，您下周应该会收到贷款的批准信。
